LanguageData.DMS_FlashShock.label: Assault Flash
LanguageData.DMS_FlashShock.description: Activate the assault flash array to temporarily blind incoming enemies; the device slowly recharges from the protector's own power supply afterward. Facing a large mob, a protector squad can chain-fire their arrays to incapacitate the crowd while subduing the dazed rioters with riot shotguns and stun batons.
